# Source artifacts API

Read source snapshot metadata used by builds and workspace hydration. Artifacts are created through source upload and build workflows.

Use [API authentication](authentication.md) for protected requests. Examples use your own resource IDs and a temporary token; saved response examples are synthetic.

| Method | Path | Operation |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `GET` | `/v1/source_artifact` | [List source artifacts](#op-get-v1-source-artifact) |
| `GET` | `/v1/source_artifact/{id}` | [Get source artifact](#op-get-v1-source-artifact-id) |

## List source artifacts {#op-get-v1-source-artifact}

`GET /v1/source_artifact`

Returns a paginated list of SourceArtifact

Authentication: bearer token and the team header shown below.

### Parameters

| Name | Location | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `X-Tenant-ID` | header | yes | Active team ID. Must match the tenant bound to a diagnostic token. |
| `page` | query | no | Page number |
| `per_page` | query | no | Items per page |

### Request example

Set `ADIOS_API_URL=https://api.adios.dev`. For protected requests, set `ADIOS_ACCESS_TOKEN` and `ADIOS_TEAM_ID` as in the [quickstart](quickstart.md). Set any additional `ADIOS_*` variables from your own resource results.

```sh
curl --fail-with-body --request GET "$ADIOS_API_URL/v1/source_artifact" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADIOS_ACCESS_TOKEN" \
  -H "X-Tenant-ID: $ADIOS_TEAM_ID"
```


### Response: HTTP 200

List of SourceArtifact

### Response fields

| Field | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `data` | array |  |
| `data[].branch` | string |  |
| `data[].build_id` | string | Build that was produced from this source snapshot |
| `data[].commit_sha` | string |  |
| `data[].content_type` | string |  |
| `data[].created_at` | integer |  (Unix timestamp) |
| `data[].deleted_at` | integer |  (Unix timestamp) |
| `data[].digest` | string | Content digest of the source bundle |
| `data[].metadata` | object |  |
| `data[].repository_url` | string | Git repository URL when source_type is git |
| `data[].size_bytes` | integer |  |
| `data[].source_artifact_id` | string |  |
| `data[].source_type` | string |  Allowed: upload, git, workspace, template, unknown. |
| `data[].system_artifact_id` | string | System object artifact identifier for the source bundle |
| `data[].system_object_key` | string |  |
| `data[].system_uri` | string |  |
| `data[].team_id` | string |  |
| `data[].updated_at` | integer |  (Unix timestamp) |
| `data[].workload_id` | string |  |
| `pagination` | object |  |
| `pagination.page` | integer | Current page number |
| `pagination.per_page` | integer | Number of items per page |
| `pagination.total` | integer | Total number of items |

Illustrative example; not a live response:

```json
{
  "data": [
    {
      "branch": "",
      "build_id": "example",
      "commit_sha": "",
      "content_type": "",
      "created_at": 1791072000,
      "deleted_at": 0,
      "digest": "",
      "metadata": {},
      "repository_url": "example",
      "size_bytes": 0,
      "source_artifact_id": "000000000000000000000000001",
      "source_type": "unknown",
      "system_artifact_id": "example",
      "system_object_key": "",
      "system_uri": "",
      "team_id": "000000000000000000000000001",
      "updated_at": 1791072000,
      "workload_id": "000000000000000000000000001"
    }
  ],
  "pagination": {
    "page": 1,
    "per_page": 1,
    "total": 1
  }
}
```


## Get source artifact {#op-get-v1-source-artifact-id}

`GET /v1/source_artifact/{id}`

Returns a single SourceArtifact

Set `source_artifact_id` using IDs from your own API responses.

Authentication: bearer token and the team header shown below.

### Parameters

| Name | Location | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | path | yes | Resource identifier from your team's API results. |
| `X-Tenant-ID` | header | yes | Active team ID. Must match the tenant bound to a diagnostic token. |

### Request example

Set `ADIOS_API_URL=https://api.adios.dev`. For protected requests, set `ADIOS_ACCESS_TOKEN` and `ADIOS_TEAM_ID` as in the [quickstart](quickstart.md). Set any additional `ADIOS_*` variables from your own resource results.

```sh
curl --fail-with-body --request GET "$ADIOS_API_URL/v1/source_artifact/${ADIOS_SOURCE_ARTIFACT_ID}" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADIOS_ACCESS_TOKEN" \
  -H "X-Tenant-ID: $ADIOS_TEAM_ID"
```


### Response: HTTP 200

SourceArtifact

### Response fields

| Field | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `branch` | string |  |
| `build_id` | string | Build that was produced from this source snapshot |
| `commit_sha` | string |  |
| `content_type` | string |  |
| `created_at` | integer |  (Unix timestamp) |
| `deleted_at` | integer |  (Unix timestamp) |
| `digest` | string | Content digest of the source bundle |
| `metadata` | object |  |
| `repository_url` | string | Git repository URL when source_type is git |
| `size_bytes` | integer |  |
| `source_artifact_id` | string |  |
| `source_type` | string |  Allowed: upload, git, workspace, template, unknown. |
| `system_artifact_id` | string | System object artifact identifier for the source bundle |
| `system_object_key` | string |  |
| `system_uri` | string |  |
| `team_id` | string |  |
| `updated_at` | integer |  (Unix timestamp) |
| `workload_id` | string |  |
